Theme

House layout, roofs, rooms & furnishings

ground level phrase

also at ground level

classical

Vitruvius 6.8.1: aedificia quae plānō pede īnstituuntur (Lewis & Short cites the older numbering 6.11)
Vitruvius 7.4.1: conclāvibus, quae plānō pede fuerint

plānō pede

at ground level, entered without steps

Examples

  • Hīc plānō pede intrāmus; illīc dēscendimus in hypogēum.

    Here we walk straight in; over there we go down to the basement.composed

See also basement, ground floor, slope, upright, crossbar.

SourcesLewis & Short: planus

The example sentence marked “composed” is ours.
